Architecture, APIs, databases, integrations, reliability, and debugging. Designed and implemented 70+ REST API routes across SnapCart and Rydex with authentication, payments, real-time features, and geospatial queries.

Customer and business understanding

Requirements discovery, stakeholder communication, workflow mapping, and translating business objectives into technical specifications. Applied Jobs-to-Be-Done framework to understand user progress and design appropriate solutions.

AI implementation

LLM workflows, structured outputs, and agent orchestration. Integrated Gemini AI for intelligent quick-reply suggestions in SnapCart and Rydex chat systems.

Deployment and adoption

Production readiness, observability, documentation, onboarding, iteration, and measurable outcomes. Built complete workflows from problem scoping through testing and deployment planning.

Demonstrated through projects:

SnapCart: Translating grocery commerce and logistics requirements into a multi-role application with payment and delivery workflows. Built order lifecycle from cart through payment, assignment, live tracking, and OTP confirmation.
Rydex: Translating transportation, onboarding, and marketplace requirements into integrated booking, geospatial, payment, and verification systems. Designed eight-step partner onboarding with video KYC and commission calculations.
Health Map: Defining a real-world discovery problem, identifying stakeholders, choosing a geospatial architecture (PostGIS), and planning delivery stages. Demonstrating FDE approach through requirements analysis and system design.
